title: Operating conditions of the Culver SBR process

cell_spans.description: Printed 'Mode of Operation (minutes)' spans the seven time columns
Printed 'Average flow (MLD)' spans both header rows
Printed 'Number of Basins' spans both header rows

markdown:
| Average flow (MLD) | Fill and Mix | Fill and Aeration | React | Settle | Decant | Idle | Total cycle time | Number of Basins | MLSS (mg/L) | F/M (a) | SRT (days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.34 | 54 | 126 | 42 | 42 | 42 | 60 | 366 | 2 | 5,000 | 0.08-0.16 | 15.5 |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Source: USEPA, 1986, USEPA, 1983'.

Transcriber layout note: three printed levels. Level 1 reads 'Average flow (MLD) / Mode of Operation (minutes) / Number of Basins / MLSS (mg/L) / F/M (a) / SRT (days)'; level 2 reads the seven time columns 'Fill and Mix / Fill and Aeration / React / Settle / Decant / Idle / Total cycle time'; level 3 is the single data row. Header labels are flattened to the printed leaf labels.
The six printed phase times add up to the printed total: 54 + 126 + 42 + 42 + 42 + 60 = 366 minutes. Not corrected or recomputed in the cell values.
Printed 'F/M (a)' has no unit after the 'a'; retained.
Unit case is printed 'MLSS (mg/L)' and 'F/M (a)' here while neighbouring tables print 'mg/l'; retained.
Printed 'Total cycle time' header wraps over three lines inside its column; joined with spaces.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Header levels and the single data row read from a 350 dpi crop; the twelve values, including '0.08-0.16' and '5,000', checked one by one.
